periods.summary: In the infirmary, Lisha reveals to Lux the old Arcadia Empire brand below her navel and asks him to keep it secret.
periods.cause: Lux had seen the hidden mark during the bath incident and Lisha wants to secure his silence and trust.
periods.process: Lisha awkwardly shows the brand, explains that it must remain hidden, and Lux swears on his Sword Device not to tell anyone.
periods.outcome: Lux becomes Lisha's trusted secret-holder and Lisha's hostility softens into affection and reliance.
periods.aftermath: Lisha pushes for Lux to stay as a student and later confides more of her hostage past during their outing.
periods.significance: Creates the central trust bond between Lux and Lisha and exposes the political danger of Lisha's origin.
